column_description: Unique identifier for each data point.
Timestamp of when the data point was recorded. may be NULL.
X position in the 3D coordinate system. may be NULL.
Y position in the 3D coordinate system. may be NULL.
Z position in the 3D coordinate system. may be NULL.
Yaw angle (rotation around the Z-axis). may be NULL.
Pitch angle (rotation around the X-axis). may be NULL.
Roll angle (rotation around the Y-axis). may be NULL.
ID of the sensor or device that recorded the data point. may be NULL.
Quality of the data point (e.g., good, bad, uncertain). always exactly one of 'good', 'bad', 'uncertain'. may be NULL.
Sampling rate of the sensor or device. may be NULL.
Source of the data (e.g., sensor, simulation, external system). always exactly one of 'sensor', 'simulation', 'external system'. may be NULL.
